title: The Tenth Sub Level of Suicide
desc_lfm_album: The Tenth Sub Level of Suicide is the debut studio album by American black metal musical act Leviathan. It was recorded entirely on a Tascam four-track tape recorder using a Line 6 Pod in mainman Wrest's home, and was released in September 29, 2003 from Seattle, Washington-based underground record label, Moribund Cult. "It's about different phases/levels of contemplation towards an action. The act of self-extermination", says Wrest. "All the lyrics, for the exception of 'track' two, are about suicide, in one form or another." .
desc_lfm_artist:
There are multiple artists using this name.

1. Leviathan is the black metal project of American artist Jef Whitehead, aka 'Wrest'. He began the project in 1998. Though he was originally based in San Francisco, California, he later moved and is now located in Portland, Oregon. Leviathan was put on hold in October 2007 due to a legal dispute with the record label. Wrest brought the project back in January 2008 to release Massive Conspiracy Against All Life.
